items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now Cink Martin played an iron bass on occasion... [INTERVIEWEE] I mean I just didn't hear him do it.

ctx.x: The only brass bass player that I can think of that was playing inside then in those days was a guy called Lefty Ironman, who played with Buck Banville at the Plum Plant, the American Legion Dance Hall. That may have been a place you didn't go to.
Now Cink Martin played an iron bass on occasion. He was a good bass player too. Good tuba player. Cink Martin. But not often.
I mean I just didn't hear him do it.
